name: ukb23374_wgs_qc_applet
title: GraphTyper WGS QC Applet
summary: WGS QC applet. Takes a list of vcf file IDs or paths in a single file. Runs a bunch of pre-defined filters. Creates plink2 files, sites-only vcfs, variant counts per sample, and quality scores per variant.

inputSpec.name: ukb23374_vcf_list
inputSpec.label: VCF list
inputSpec.help: Input file ID (hash file-xxxxx). Contains a list of vcf file IDs or full paths from field 23374, one per line

inputSpec.name: mem_per_vcf
inputSpec.label: RAM per VCF
inputSpec.help: Used to determine how many VCFs to process in parallel

outputSpec.name: qc_log_files
outputSpec.label: Log files
outputSpec.help: Text file with concatenated STDERR files.

outputSpec.name: qc_output_files
outputSpec.label: Output files
outputSpec.help: Nine files per VCF: Plink2 PGEN file set (pgen, pvar, psam.gz) under /pfiles), bed file (bed) and indexed sites-only BCF (bcf, bcf.csi) under /sites, tables of variant scores (tsv.gz) and per-sample variant counts (tsv.gz) under /stats, and a list of these qc outputs (txt) under /logs
